info.title: Invoice API v1
info.description:
Invoice API for integrating external systems. Authenticate with a Bearer token from **API tokens**. Each token is limited to the Profile it was created for.

Optional fields use defaults when omitted. Relations use a selection mode: send `*_selection_mode` as `existing` (find by selector fields) or `new` (create fields on the same object).

Use the base URL below and send `Accept: application/json` and `Content-Type: application/json`. Error responses use a JSON `message` field; validation errors (422) also include an `errors` object.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Create and manage invoices. Optional fields use defaults when omitted. Relations use a selection mode: `existing` (use an existing record — send at least one lookup field such as `uuid`) or `new` (create a new record — send create fields on the same object, no nested `create` key). When creating a Recipient or Payer (`*_selection_mode` = `new`), Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required if Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true. Type must match Category: for `product` use `prepayment`, `bill_of_landing`, or `credit` (or a custom type UUID); for `service` use `prepayment`, `post_payment`, `actual`, or `credit` (or a custom type UUID). Built-in Type, VAT rate, Unit, and Category values with meanings are listed on each request field.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Manage clients used as Recipient and Payer on invoices. Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

tags.name: Invoice lines
tags.description: Manage Invoice lines on an existing invoice. Related VAT rate and Product catalog entries can be found by UUID when provided.

tags.name: Bank accounts
tags.description: Manage supplier bank accounts on `/bank-accounts`. Manage client bank accounts on `/clients/{client}/bank-accounts`.

tags.name: Product catalog
tags.description: Manage Product catalog entries used on Invoice lines. Name accepts a string for all languages or a translation object `{"en":"…","lv":"…"}` (languages: `en` English, `lv` Latviešu). Price and Currency are required together (send both or neither). Quantity is allowed only when Count quantity is true. Catalog products can also be found or created when adding Invoice lines.

tags.name: VAT rates
tags.description: Manage VAT rates. Built-in rates `21`, `12`, `5`, and `0` (zero rate) are always available and cannot be created again. VAT not applicable uses a Label with no rate (`value` null). Either VAT rate or Label is required (not both omitted). Optional VAT reference accepts built-in codes (each with a meaning listed on the field) or free text. VAT rates can also be found or created when adding Invoice lines.

tags.name: Invoice numbers
tags.description: Manage Invoice numbers (invoice number series). One series can be marked Use by default.

tags.name: Invoice types
tags.description: Manage Invoice types per Category (`product` = Product — invoice for goods; `service` = Service — invoice for services). Built-in types already exist and cannot be changed or deleted. For Category `product`: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `bill_of_landing` (Bill of landing — delivery accompanying document), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount). For Category `service`: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `post_payment` (Post-payment — pay after delivery), `actual` (Actual — final invoice for the actual transaction), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount). When creating an invoice, send a built-in key or the UUID of a custom type from this list. Name accepts a string for all languages or a translation object `{"en":"…","lv":"…"}`.

post.description:
Optional fields use defaults when omitted (for example Date defaults to today, Currency to `EUR` (Euro), Language to the account language).
For Recipient, Payer, Invoice number, and Bank accounts send `*_selection_mode` as `existing` (use an existing record — send at least one lookup field such as `uuid`) or `new` (create with fields on the same object; no nested `create` key).
When Payer matches the recipient is false, Payer and `payer_bank_account` are required.
When creating a Recipient or Payer: Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required if Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.
Type must match Category — see the Type field for allowed built-in keys and meanings per Category (or send a custom type UUID from the Invoice types list).
On Invoice lines, Name / Unit / Price without VAT are required unless Product catalog is linked and provides them.

get.description: Returns one invoice by UUID, including Recipient, Payer, Bank accounts, and Invoice lines as snapshots stored on the invoice.

put.description: Only sent fields are changed. Category, Type, and Recipient are optional on update (`sometimes`). Relations use the same `existing` / `new` selection modes as create. Type must still match Category when both are sent.

delete.description: Archives the invoice. Use Restore to bring it back, or Delete to remove it permanently.
Permanently deletes an archived invoice. This action cannot be undone.

post.description:
Creates one Invoice type for each Category in `categories` and returns the first created type.
Name accepts either a string for every language (e.g. `"Consulting"`) or an object per language (e.g. `{"en":"Consulting","lv":"Konsultācijas"}`).

get.description: Returns a single invoice type by UUID.

put.description: Updates the given invoice type fields.

is_sync_enabled.description: Data synchronization by registration number with company registers

uuid.description: UUID from the Product catalog list.

name.description: Name translations. Object with locale keys, e.g. `{"en":"Consulting","lv":"Konsultācijas"}`. On create/update you may send a string (applied to all languages) or this same translation object.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in examples: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also allowed.

quantity.description: Stock quantity when Count quantity is enabled.

currency.description: Currency as ISO 4217 code, e.g. `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar).

is_quantity_counted.description: Whether stock quantity is tracked for this catalog product.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in examples: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also allowed.

discount.description: Discount amount or percent (see Discount type).

discount_type.description: Discount type. Enum: `percent` (Percent — discount as a percentage of the line), `flat` (Flat — fixed amount discount).

tax.description: VAT percent on the line (e.g. `21`). `0` is 0% VAT; `null` means VAT not applicable.

invoice_number.description: Full invoice number as shown on the document.

invoice_category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

invoice_type.description: Invoice type name snapshot stored on this invoice (resolved text for the invoice language, e.g. "Prepayment"). On create/update, send `invoice_type` as a built-in key (e.g. `prepayment`) or a UUID from the Invoice types list.

invoice_locale.description: Language of the invoice document. Enum: `lv` (Latviešu), `en` (English).

invoice_note.description: Invoice note shown on the document.

payment_method.description: Payment method. Enum: `bank_transfer` (Bank transfer), `bank_card` (Payment by debit/credit card), `cash` (Cash payment), `upon_delivery` (Payment after a sale).

currency.description: Currency as ISO 4217 code, e.g. `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar).

payer_is_recipient.description: Whether the payer matches the recipient.

is_public_link.description: Whether the public invoice link is enabled.

tax_summary.description: VAT summary breakdown on the invoice.

team.description: Supplier (Piegādātājs) snapshot stored on this invoice.

recipient.description: Recipient (buyer) snapshot stored on this invoice.

payer.description: Payer snapshot stored on this invoice.

team_bank_account.description: Supplier bank account snapshot stored on this invoice.

recipient_bank_account.description: Recipient bank account snapshot stored on this invoice.

payer_bank_account.description: Payer bank account snapshot stored on this invoice.

uuid.description: UUID from the Invoice types list. Use this UUID (or the built-in `key`) when creating an invoice.

key.description: Built-in Type key. Present only for built-in types; `null` for custom types. Depends on Category — for `product` (Product): `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `bill_of_landing` (Bill of landing — delivery accompanying document), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount); for `service` (Service): `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `post_payment` (Post-payment — pay after delivery), `actual` (Actual — final invoice for the actual transaction), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount).

is_system.description: `true` if this is a built-in type that cannot be changed or deleted.

name.description: Name translations. Object with locale keys, e.g. `{"en":"Prepayment","lv":"Priekšapmaksa"}`. On create/update you may send a string (applied to all languages) or this same translation object.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

default_note.description: Default invoice note automatically added when this type is selected.

signature_type.description: Invoice signature note on the document. Enum: `paper_with_signature_fields` (Paper document with signature fields), `electronic_without_signature` (Electronic document, valid without signature), `electronic_with_e_signature` (Electronic document, signed with e-signature), `without_signature_note` (Without note about invoice signature).

uuid.description: UUID from the VAT rates list.

value.description: VAT rate percent (e.g. `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`). Null when using a Label instead (VAT not applicable / custom label).

label.description: Custom label when the rate is not a simple percent (alternative to VAT rate).

vat_reference.description: VAT reference code or free text shown on the invoice. See create VAT rate for the full list of built-in codes with meanings.

reference_id.description: Reference ID. Identifier (ID) from an external system, optional field.

reg_no.description: Reg. No. / Per. ID. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

address.description: Address. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

country.description: Country. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

is_self_employed.description: Self-employed. When true, Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required.

is_sync_enabled.description: Data synchronization by registration number with company registers

name.description: Name. Accepts either (1) a string used for every language, e.g. `"Consulting"`, or (2) an object with text per language, e.g. `{"en":"Consulting","lv":"Konsultācijas"}`. Languages: `en` (English), `lv` (Latviešu). When sending an object, at least one language must be non-empty. Max 255 characters per value.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted.

quantity.description: Quantity in stock. Allowed only when Count quantity is true; must be omitted when Count quantity is false.

price.description: Price without VAT. Required when Currency is sent. Send Price and Currency together, or omit both.

anyOf.description: Currency as ISO 4217 code. Required when Price is sent. Examples: `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar). Send Price and Currency together, or omit both.

is_quantity_counted.description: Count quantity. When true, stock Quantity may be sent; when false, Quantity must be omitted.

anyOf.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

name.description: Line Name. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

code.description: Line Code. Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

price.description: Price without VAT. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

discount.description: Discount amount or percent (see Discount type). Optional; defaults to 0.

discount_type.description: Discount type. Enum: `percent` (Percent — discount as a percentage of the line), `flat` (Flat — fixed amount discount).

tax.description: VAT percent on the line. Optional. `null` = VAT not applicable; `0` = 0% rate. Common rates: `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`.

invoice_vat.description: Linked VAT rate. Optional UUID from the VAT rates list (includes built-in rates `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`).

invoice_catalog_product.description: Linked Product catalog entry. Optional UUID from the Product catalog list. When set, omitted Name / Code / Unit / Category / Price without VAT are taken from the catalog.

invoice_category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Required. Determines which Type keys are allowed.

invoice_type.description: Type. Must match Category. Send either (1) a built-in Type key valid for that Category, or (2) the UUID of a custom Invoice type from the Invoice types list for that Category. Category `product` (Product) — only these keys: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `bill_of_landing` (Bill of landing — delivery accompanying document), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount). Category `service` (Service) — only these keys: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `post_payment` (Post-payment — pay after delivery), `actual` (Actual — final invoice for the actual transaction), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount).

invoice_note.description: Invoice note. Free text shown on the invoice (max 5000 characters).

payer_is_recipient.description: Payer matches the recipient. Optional; defaults to true. When false, you must also send Payer (`payer` + `payer_selection_mode`) and Payer bank account (`payer_bank_account` + `payer_bank_account_selection_mode`).

invoiced_at.description: Date of the invoice. Format `d.m.Y`, e.g. `05.08.2026`. Optional; defaults to today.

expires_at.description: Payment term (due date). Format `d.m.Y`, e.g. `20.08.2026`. Optional; if omitted, calculated from Invoice payment days on the Invoice number series.

anyOf.description: Language of the invoice document. Enum: `lv` (Latviešu), `en` (English). Optional; defaults to the account language.
Currency as ISO 4217 code. Examples: `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar). Optional; defaults to `EUR` (Euro).
Payment method. Enum: `bank_transfer` (Bank transfer), `bank_card` (Payment by debit/credit card), `cash` (Cash payment), `upon_delivery` (Payment after a sale). Optional.

show_code.description: Show the product Code column on the printed/PDF invoice. Optional; defaults to false.

show_discount.description: Show the Discount column on the printed/PDF invoice. Optional; defaults to false.

paid_advance.description: Paid advance already received. Optional; defaults to 0.

is_public_link.description: Enable invoice link (public URL for the client). Optional; defaults from the Invoice number series setting.

products.description: Invoice lines. Optional array. When a Product catalog entry is linked on a line, omitted Name / Code / Unit / Category / Price without VAT are taken from the catalog. Values you send on the line override the catalog.

anyOf.description: Line Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

name.description: Line Name. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

code.description: Line Code. Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

price.description: Price without VAT. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

discount.description: Discount amount or percent (see Discount type). Optional; defaults to 0.

anyOf.description: Discount type. Enum: `percent` (Percent — discount as a percentage of the line), `flat` (Flat — fixed amount discount). Optional.

tax.description: VAT percent on the line. Optional. `null` = VAT not applicable; `0` = 0% rate. Common rates: `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`.

invoice_vat_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the VAT rate for this line. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing VAT rate — send at least one of `uuid`, `value`, or `label` on `invoice_vat`), `new` (Create a new VAT rate — send create fields on `invoice_vat`). Required when `invoice_vat` is sent.

invoice_vat.description: VAT rate for this line. Optional. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` (from the VAT rates list), `value` (rate percent), or `label`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (VAT rate and/or Label, optional VAT reference).

invoice_catalog_product_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Product catalog entry for this line. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing catalog product — send at least one of `uuid`, `code`, or `name` on `invoice_catalog_product`), `new` (Create a new catalog product — send create fields on `invoice_catalog_product`). Required when `invoice_catalog_product` is sent.

invoice_catalog_product.description: Product catalog entry for this line. Optional. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` (from the Product catalog list), `code`, or `name`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (Name accepts a string for all languages or `{"en":"…","lv":"…"}`). When linked, omitted Name / Code / Unit / Category / Price without VAT are taken from the catalog.

recipient_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Recipient. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing client — send at least one of `uuid`, `reference_id`, `reg_no`, or `name` on `recipient`), `new` (Create a new client — send create fields on `recipient`). Required.

recipient.description: Recipient (buyer). Required. With `existing`, look up by at least one of: `uuid`, `reference_id` (external ID), `reg_no` (Reg. No. / Per. ID), or `name`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (no nested `create` key). For new clients: Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required if Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

payer_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Payer. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing client), `new` (Create a new client). Required when Payer matches the recipient is false, or when `payer` is sent.

payer.description: Payer. Required when Payer matches the recipient is false. Same lookup/create rules as Recipient.

invoice_numerator_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Invoice number series. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing series — send `uuid` or `shortcode` on `invoice_numerator`), `new` (Create a new series — send create fields on `invoice_numerator`). Optional when using the default series.

invoice_numerator.description: Invoice number series. Optional; defaults to the series marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `shortcode` (series scheme). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

team_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Supplier bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number` on `team_bank_account`), `new` (Create a new account). Optional when using the default supplier bank account.

team_bank_account.description: Supplier bank account. Optional; defaults to the account marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

recipient_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Recipient bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number`), `new` (Create a new account). Optional when using the default recipient bank account.

recipient_bank_account.description: Recipient bank account. Optional; defaults to the account marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

payer_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Payer bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number`), `new` (Create a new account). Required when Payer matches the recipient is false, or when `payer_bank_account` is sent.

payer_bank_account.description: Payer bank account. Required when Payer matches the recipient is false. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

name.description: Name. Accepts either (1) a string used for every language, e.g. `"Prepayment invoice"`, or (2) an object with text per language, e.g. `{"en":"Prepayment invoice","lv":"Priekšapmaksas rēķins"}`. Languages: `en` (English), `lv` (Latviešu). When sending an object, at least one language must be non-empty. Max 255 characters per value.

categories.description: Categories to create this type for. One Invoice type record is created per listed category. Enum values: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Example: `["product","service"]`.

items.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

default_note.description: Invoice note. This text is automatically added as the invoice note when this type is selected (max 5000 characters).

signature_type.description: Invoice signature note on the document. Enum: `paper_with_signature_fields` (Paper document with signature fields), `electronic_without_signature` (Electronic document, valid without signature), `electronic_with_e_signature` (Electronic document, signed with e-signature), `without_signature_note` (Without note about invoice signature).

value.description: VAT rate percent. Required when Label is omitted. Built-in rates `21`, `12`, `5`, `0` already exist and cannot be created again — send a different rate or a Label instead. Omit value (use Label) for VAT not applicable.

label.description: Custom label when the rate is not a simple percent (alternative to VAT rate). Required when VAT rate is omitted. Max 10 characters.

vat_reference.description: VAT reference text shown on the invoice. Prefer a built-in code, or send free text (max 1000 characters). Built-in codes: `0` (Other), `1` (Provision of construction services), `6` (Sale of scrap metal and timber), `7` (Provision of services to a taxable person registered in another EU member state where the place of supply is determined under Section 1 of Article 19 of the VAT Law), `8` (Supply of goods within the EU to a taxable person registered in another EU member state), `9` (Provision of services to a taxable person registered in a third country where the place of supply is determined under Section 1 of Article 19 of the VAT Law), `10` (Export of goods), `11` (Sale of used immovable property), `12` (Invoice issued by the recipient of goods or services), `13` (Supply of a new means of transport), `14` (Supply of goods or provision of services applying the cash accounting principle), `15` (Provision of tourism services), `16` (Supply of second-hand goods), `17` (Supply of works of art), `18` (Supply of collectors' items and antiques), `19` (Supply of mobile phones, tablets, laptops, integrated circuit devices and gaming consoles), `20` (Sale of cereals and industrial crops, including oilseeds, including mixtures thereof not normally intended for final consumption in their unaltered state), `21` (Sale of unprocessed precious metals, precious metal alloys and precious metal-plated metals), `23` (Sale of used goods), `25` (Provision of services related to scrap metal supplies), `26` (Supply of scrap metal), `27` (Supply of timber), `28` (Provision of services related to timber supplies), `29` (Supply of metal products), `30` (Provision of services related to metal product supplies), `31` (Supply of construction products), `32` (Supply of household electronic equipment and household electrical apparatus).

reference_id.description: Reference ID. Identifier (ID) from an external system, optional field.

reg_no.description: Reg. No. / Per. ID. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

address.description: Address. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

country.description: Country. Required when Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

is_self_employed.description: Self-employed. When true, Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required.

is_sync_enabled.description: Data synchronization by registration number with company registers

name.description: Name. Accepts either (1) a string used for every language, e.g. `"Consulting"`, or (2) an object with text per language, e.g. `{"en":"Consulting","lv":"Konsultācijas"}`. Languages: `en` (English), `lv` (Latviešu). When sending an object, at least one language must be non-empty. Max 255 characters per value.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted.

price.description: Price without VAT. Required when Currency is sent. Send Price and Currency together, or omit both.

anyOf.description: Currency as ISO 4217 code. Required when Price is sent. Examples: `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar). Send Price and Currency together, or omit both.

is_quantity_counted.description: Count quantity. When true, stock quantity is tracked for this catalog product. This update endpoint does not accept a Quantity field (quantity is managed separately).

anyOf.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted.

discount.description: Discount amount or percent (see Discount type). Optional; defaults to 0.

discount_type.description: Discount type. Enum: `percent` (Percent — discount as a percentage of the line), `flat` (Flat — fixed amount discount).

tax.description: VAT percent on the line. Optional. `null` = VAT not applicable; `0` = 0% rate. Common rates: `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`.

invoice_vat.description: Linked VAT rate. Optional UUID from the VAT rates list (includes built-in rates `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`).

invoice_catalog_product.description: Linked Product catalog entry. Optional UUID from the Product catalog list.

invoice_category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Required. Determines which Type keys are allowed.

invoice_type.description: Type. Must match Category. Send either (1) a built-in Type key valid for that Category, or (2) the UUID of a custom Invoice type from the Invoice types list for that Category. Category `product` (Product) — only these keys: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `bill_of_landing` (Bill of landing — delivery accompanying document), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount). Category `service` (Service) — only these keys: `prepayment` (Prepayment — pay before delivery), `post_payment` (Post-payment — pay after delivery), `actual` (Actual — final invoice for the actual transaction), `credit` (Credit — reduces a previously issued amount).

invoice_note.description: Invoice note. Free text shown on the invoice (max 5000 characters).

payer_is_recipient.description: Payer matches the recipient. Optional; defaults to true. When false, you must also send Payer (`payer` + `payer_selection_mode`) and Payer bank account (`payer_bank_account` + `payer_bank_account_selection_mode`).

invoiced_at.description: Date of the invoice. Format `d.m.Y`, e.g. `05.08.2026`. Optional; defaults to today.

expires_at.description: Payment term (due date). Format `d.m.Y`, e.g. `20.08.2026`. Optional; if omitted, calculated from Invoice payment days on the Invoice number series.

anyOf.description: Language of the invoice document. Enum: `lv` (Latviešu), `en` (English). Optional; defaults to the account language.
Currency as ISO 4217 code. Examples: `EUR` (Euro), `USD` (US Dollar). Optional; defaults to `EUR` (Euro).
Payment method. Enum: `bank_transfer` (Bank transfer), `bank_card` (Payment by debit/credit card), `cash` (Cash payment), `upon_delivery` (Payment after a sale). Optional.

show_code.description: Show the product Code column on the printed/PDF invoice. Optional; defaults to false.

show_discount.description: Show the Discount column on the printed/PDF invoice. Optional; defaults to false.

paid_advance.description: Paid advance already received. Optional; defaults to 0.

is_public_link.description: Enable invoice link (public URL for the client). Optional; defaults from the Invoice number series setting.

products.description: Invoice lines. Optional array. When a Product catalog entry is linked on a line, omitted Name / Code / Unit / Category / Price without VAT are taken from the catalog. Values you send on the line override the catalog.

anyOf.description: Line Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services). Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

name.description: Line Name. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

code.description: Line Code. Optional; filled from Product catalog when omitted.

measurement.description: Unit. Built-in: `pieces` (pcs), `days` (d), `years` (y), `hours` (h), `kilograms` (kg), `litres` (l), `metres` (m), `square_metres` (m²), `cubic_metres` (m³), `kilowatt_hours` (kWh), `months` (mo). Custom unit strings are also accepted. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

price.description: Price without VAT. Required unless Product catalog is linked and provides it.

discount.description: Discount amount or percent (see Discount type). Optional; defaults to 0.

anyOf.description: Discount type. Enum: `percent` (Percent — discount as a percentage of the line), `flat` (Flat — fixed amount discount). Optional.

tax.description: VAT percent on the line. Optional. `null` = VAT not applicable; `0` = 0% rate. Common rates: `21`, `12`, `5`, `0`.

invoice_vat_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the VAT rate for this line. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing VAT rate — send at least one of `uuid`, `value`, or `label` on `invoice_vat`), `new` (Create a new VAT rate — send create fields on `invoice_vat`). Required when `invoice_vat` is sent.

invoice_vat.description: VAT rate for this line. Optional. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` (from the VAT rates list), `value` (rate percent), or `label`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (VAT rate and/or Label, optional VAT reference).

invoice_catalog_product_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Product catalog entry for this line. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing catalog product — send at least one of `uuid`, `code`, or `name` on `invoice_catalog_product`), `new` (Create a new catalog product — send create fields on `invoice_catalog_product`). Required when `invoice_catalog_product` is sent.

invoice_catalog_product.description: Product catalog entry for this line. Optional. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` (from the Product catalog list), `code`, or `name`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (Name accepts a string for all languages or `{"en":"…","lv":"…"}`). When linked, omitted Name / Code / Unit / Category / Price without VAT are taken from the catalog.

recipient_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Recipient. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing client — send at least one of `uuid`, `reference_id`, `reg_no`, or `name` on `recipient`), `new` (Create a new client — send create fields on `recipient`). Required.

recipient.description: Recipient (buyer). Required. With `existing`, look up by at least one of: `uuid`, `reference_id` (external ID), `reg_no` (Reg. No. / Per. ID), or `name`. With `new`, send create fields on this object (no nested `create` key). For new clients: Reg. No. / Per. ID, Address, and Country are required if Type is `company` (Legal entity) or Self-employed is true.

payer_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Payer. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing client), `new` (Create a new client). Required when Payer matches the recipient is false, or when `payer` is sent.

payer.description: Payer. Required when Payer matches the recipient is false. Same lookup/create rules as Recipient.

invoice_numerator_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Invoice number series. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing series — send `uuid` or `shortcode` on `invoice_numerator`), `new` (Create a new series — send create fields on `invoice_numerator`). Optional when using the default series.

invoice_numerator.description: Invoice number series. Optional; defaults to the series marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `shortcode` (series scheme). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

team_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Supplier bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number` on `team_bank_account`), `new` (Create a new account). Optional when using the default supplier bank account.

team_bank_account.description: Supplier bank account. Optional; defaults to the account marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

recipient_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Recipient bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number`), `new` (Create a new account). Optional when using the default recipient bank account.

recipient_bank_account.description: Recipient bank account. Optional; defaults to the account marked Use by default. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

payer_bank_account_selection_mode.description: How to resolve the Payer bank account. Enum: `existing` (Use an existing account — send `uuid` or `number`), `new` (Create a new account). Required when Payer matches the recipient is false, or when `payer_bank_account` is sent.

payer_bank_account.description: Payer bank account. Required when Payer matches the recipient is false. With `existing`, look up by `uuid` or `number` (IBAN). With `new`, send create fields on this object.

name.description: Name. Accepts either (1) a string used for every language, e.g. `"Prepayment invoice"`, or (2) an object with text per language, e.g. `{"en":"Prepayment invoice","lv":"Priekšapmaksas rēķins"}`. Languages: `en` (English), `lv` (Latviešu). When sending an object, at least one language must be non-empty. Max 255 characters per value.

category.description: Category. Enum: `product` (Product — invoice for goods), `service` (Service — invoice for services).

default_note.description: Invoice note. This text is automatically added as the invoice note when this type is selected (max 5000 characters).

signature_type.description: Invoice signature note on the document. Enum: `paper_with_signature_fields` (Paper document with signature fields), `electronic_without_signature` (Electronic document, valid without signature), `electronic_with_e_signature` (Electronic document, signed with e-signature), `without_signature_note` (Without note about invoice signature).

value.description: VAT rate percent. Required when Label is omitted. Built-in rates `21`, `12`, `5`, `0` already exist and cannot be created again — send a different rate or a Label instead. Omit value (use Label) for VAT not applicable.

label.description: Custom label when the rate is not a simple percent (alternative to VAT rate). Required when VAT rate is omitted. Max 10 characters.

vat_reference.description: VAT reference text shown on the invoice. Prefer a built-in code, or send free text (max 1000 characters). Built-in codes: `0` (Other), `1` (Provision of construction services), `6` (Sale of scrap metal and timber), `7` (Provision of services to a taxable person registered in another EU member state where the place of supply is determined under Section 1 of Article 19 of the VAT Law), `8` (Supply of goods within the EU to a taxable person registered in another EU member state), `9` (Provision of services to a taxable person registered in a third country where the place of supply is determined under Section 1 of Article 19 of the VAT Law), `10` (Export of goods), `11` (Sale of used immovable property), `12` (Invoice issued by the recipient of goods or services), `13` (Supply of a new means of transport), `14` (Supply of goods or provision of services applying the cash accounting principle), `15` (Provision of tourism services), `16` (Supply of second-hand goods), `17` (Supply of works of art), `18` (Supply of collectors' items and antiques), `19` (Supply of mobile phones, tablets, laptops, integrated circuit devices and gaming consoles), `20` (Sale of cereals and industrial crops, including oilseeds, including mixtures thereof not normally intended for final consumption in their unaltered state), `21` (Sale of unprocessed precious metals, precious metal alloys and precious metal-plated metals), `23` (Sale of used goods), `25` (Provision of services related to scrap metal supplies), `26` (Supply of scrap metal), `27` (Supply of timber), `28` (Provision of services related to timber supplies), `29` (Supply of metal products), `30` (Provision of services related to metal product supplies), `31` (Supply of construction products), `32` (Supply of household electronic equipment and household electrical apparatus).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
